第1039章 新剑界二（第1页）
小飞扬眉头一拧，他沉默了片刻，然后开口：“太古剑魂在哪儿？”
小飞扬点了点头，转身看向那个方向，声音平稳地吩咐：“先让它跟你去一趟，除了缥缈神宗的麻烦，不用伤及太多性命，但要让缥缈神宗知道，剑墟内的一切不是他们可以随便讨价还价的东西，新的剑界更不是任人拿捏的软柿子。”
陈越微微颔首，没有多问，转身朝剑意池的方向走去。
小飞扬收回目光，重新看向洪荒剑壁的方向。
他的目光在消失不见的入口处停了一会儿，然后他抬起右手，张开手掌。掌心处浮现出一张淡薄的人脸轮廓，那张脸如同从水面下浮起的投影，带着一丝模糊的笑意。
灰袍人的声音从掌心中传出，虽然模糊了一些，但语气依然带着一种蛊惑的意味：“他进去半年了。”
小飞扬冷冷地扫了眼掌心中的那张脸，没有说话。
灰袍人的声音继续传来，如同在陈述一件显而易见的事：“剑壁内的空间从半年前开始就没有传出过任何波动，他的修炼或许遇到了什么状况？还是说，他可能已经不在原始剑墟了？又或者，他死了也不一定。但你不一样，你是这具我们三个如今的主导者，他不在，你为何不接管这片剑墟的所有权！？”
小飞扬的手掌微微一合，那张人脸被收拢在指间，没有完全消失，只是变得比刚才更模糊了一些。
“缥缈神宗可不简单，只凭你和太古剑魂可守不住这里，你要是放我出去，或许我们能用出那三招剑经绝拭……”
小飞扬装作没有听见，这三年里，他虽然没有将灰袍人“消化”掉，对方甚至偶尔挣扎着出现，但他已经基本掌控了这具躯体，灰袍人的蛊惑只是知道自己时日无多罢了。
他沉默地看向远处的剑壁，目光仿佛穿透到剑壁深处的空间，只是等待了许久，某个他期待的回应却始终没有出现。
他垂下目光，半年前余烬告知他要进行闭关，参悟某种力量，原本计划一个月内出关，为了安全起见他临时封锁了洪荒剑壁，直到后来其列为剑界的禁地。
可是半年过去，余烬在里面却没有一点出关的迹象，他也曾经尝试着进入洪荒剑壁内进行探查，可却意外发现，剑壁空间似乎从内部进行了封闭，即使他融合了剑胎也没有进得去。
“无论如何，师祖都不可能出事，看来这次要参悟的东西，可能极为可怕。”小飞扬不得不心中猜测。
又不知道过了多久，一直守护在剑壁之外的小飞扬，忽然脸色一沉，他猛地转过身，看向剑意池所在的方向。
下一息，一股强大的战斗余波，从剑意池开始席卷开来，相连的一片片剑土眨眼被余波淹没，直至来到小飞扬身前。

小飞扬轻哼一声，随后身影拔地而起，化作一抹剑道长虹向着剑意池迅速掠去……

Chapter 1039 New Sword World II (Page 1)
Xiao Feiyang frowned, he was silent for a moment, and then said: "Where is the ancient sword spirit?"
Xiao Feiyang nodded, turned to look in that direction, and ordered in a steady voice: "Let him go with you first. Apart from the trouble of the Piaomiao Shenzong, it won't hurt too many lives, but you must let the Piaomiao Shenzong know that everything in the Sword Market is not something they can bargain with casually, and the new Sword World is not a soft persimmon that can be manipulated by others."
Chen Yue nodded slightly, turned around and walked in the direction of Jianyi Pond without asking any questions.
Xiao Feiyang withdrew his gaze and looked in the direction of the Great Sword Wall again.
His eyes paused for a moment at the disappearing entrance, then he raised his right hand and opened his palm. A faint outline of a human face appeared in the palm of the hand. The face was like a projection floating from the water, with a vague smile.
The voice of the man in gray robe came from the palm of his hand. Although it was a little blurry, his tone still had a bewitching tone: "He has been in there for half a year."
Xiao Feiyang glanced at the face in his palm coldly and said nothing.
The gray-robed man's voice continued, as if stating an obvious thing: "There has been no fluctuation in the space within the sword wall since half a year ago. What situation may have occurred in his cultivation? Or maybe he is no longer in the original Sword Ruins? Or, it is not necessarily that he is dead. But you are different. You are the current leader of the three of us. If he is gone, why don't you take over the ownership of this Sword Ruins!?"
Xiao Feiyang's palms closed slightly, and the human face was gathered between his fingers. It did not completely disappear, but became a little blurry than before.
"Piao Miao Shen Sect is not simple. Just you and the Ancient Sword Soul can't defend this place. If you let me out, maybe we can use those three moves of Sword Sutra..."
Xiao Feiyang pretended not to hear. In the past three years, although he had not "digested" the gray-robed man, and the other party even struggled to appear occasionally, he had basically controlled this body. The gray-robed man's bewitchment was just that he knew that he only had limited time.
He silently looked at the sword wall in the distance, his eyes seeming to penetrate into the space deep in the sword wall. However, after waiting for a long time, the response he expected never appeared.
He lowered his gaze. Half a year ago, Yan Yan told him that he would go into seclusion to comprehend some kind of power. He originally planned to leave the seclusion within a month. For safety reasons, he temporarily sealed off the Great Sword Wall until it was later listed as a forbidden area in the Sword World.
However, half a year later, there was no sign of Yu Yan coming out of the confinement inside. He also tried to enter the ancient sword wall to explore, but unexpectedly found that the sword wall space seemed to be sealed from the inside. Even if he fused the sword embryo, he could not get in.
"No matter what happens, nothing can happen to Master. It seems that what he wants to comprehend this time may be extremely terrifying." Xiao Feiyang had to guess in his mind.
I don't know how long it took, but Xiao Feiyang, who had been guarding the outside of the sword wall, suddenly became darkened. He turned around suddenly and looked in the direction of the Sword Intent Pond.
In the next breath, a powerful battle aftermath swept out from the Sword Intention Pool. The connected pieces of sword soil were submerged in the aftermath in the blink of an eye, until they came to Xiao Feiyang.
Xiao Feiyang snorted softly, and then his figure stood up from the ground, turning into a sword rainbow and quickly swept towards the Sword Intent Pond...
